title: ABC Plan: Roadmap Reconciliation Import
goal: Reconcile the existing markdown roadmap sprawl into a structured PlanRuntime seed, prove it locally, push it, and install it on the Debian homeserver so the live server reports the deployed commit.

feature_done_only_when: all scoped repository changes are committed
commit is pushed to the deployment branch
server install or updater run has completed after explicit operator Go when needed
server smoke checks pass or the feature is explicitly marked No-Go with evidence
handoff card records tests, commit, push, install evidence, and next feature
not_done_when: local tests pass but commit is not pushed
commit is pushed but the Debian server still runs an older version
server install was skipped without an explicit No-Go or Deferred decision
roadmap JSON exists but future agents cannot derive context from accepted events

current_evidence.notes: Initial structured multiagent roadmap and 2026-06-22 launch prompt.

current_evidence.value: eb260f5a Add Telegram rich messaging roadmap nodes
current_evidence.notes: Telegram rich text and draft streaming nodes are present in the structured roadmap.
Debian homeserver target is odysseus-homeserver, root /opt/odysseus, rootless Podman, app URL http://127.0.0.1:7000 in container.
Live update is operator-gated and must use the pre-update snapshot plus whitelisted command flow.

accepted_report_reductions.notes: Alice and Bob read-only reports are accepted as reduced context with warnings; raw reports are not the future-agent context source.

local_checks: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files

non_goals: Do not implement PlanRuntime code in this first feature.
Do not run live subagent threads.
Do not rewrite all markdown roadmaps.
Do not deploy without explicit operator Go if the server update path needs live host access.
Do not start the second roadmap feature before this one has live install evidence or a recorded No-Go/Deferred decision.
global_stop_rules: Stop on dirty worktree files outside the allowed scopes.
Stop on any staged file not owned by this feature.
Stop on secrets, tokens, chat IDs, raw private source contents, raw provider output, or unredacted server logs.
Stop if live server access fails with SSH/auth errors; request operator-provided output instead of pretending local Windows state is production.
Stop if tests fail without a narrow fix.
Stop if deployment would require destructive git, restore, rollback, prune, or broad host shell beyond the documented updater flow.
Stop if the feature cannot be installed on the server and no explicit Deferred/No-Go evidence is recorded.

preferred_path: push current branch to the deployment remote/branch
use the installed homeserver updater flow or timer
ensure pre-update snapshot gate runs before container recreate
verify app and Chroma heartbeat through existing server smoke
manual_server_commands_for_operator_or_c: podman exec odysseus_odysseus_1 sh -lc 'curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7000/api/version; echo'
go_gate: operator explicitly allows live server update
deployment branch and remote are clear
server worktree is clean or updater reports a clean state
no unrelated server-side edits would be overwritten
evidence_required: backup gate result or explicit reason why not applicable

feature_serial_execution_policy.rule: Only this feature may enter write-capable implementation until it is complete on the live server or explicitly deferred/no-go.
allowed_parallelism: server-readiness inspection that does not mutate the host
forbidden_parallelism: starting PlanRuntime implementation while reconciliation is not live
starting Roadmap Lens implementation while reconciliation is not live
starting Telegram implementation while reconciliation is not live
two agents writing the same repository or server feature at once

delegation_packets.prompt:
Alice-Slice: ABC1-alice-roadmap-inventory-report

Arbeite im Odysseus-Fork an einem read-only Report.

Ziel:
- Klassifiziere Roadmap-Artefakte fuer roadmap-reconciliation-import in active, done, deferred, stale, speculative und import-candidate.

Erlaubte Dateien:
- docs/plans/*.md
- specs/roadmaps/*.json
- specs/roadmaps/*.txt

Nicht anfassen:
- Keine Dateien aendern.
- Keine Commits.
- Keine live/server/Telegram/Provider Aktionen.
- Keine rohen privaten Inhalte, Tokens, Chat-IDs oder Serverlogs kopieren.

Anforderungen:
- Gib einen AgentReport nach dem Format aus specs/roadmaps/odysseus-multiagent-start-2026-06-22.prompt.txt zurueck.
- Nenne source_refs fuer jede Beobachtung.
- Markiere Unsicherheit als confidence low|medium|high.
- Schlage hoechstens proposed_plan_events vor; markiere nichts als verified done.

Tests:
- Keine. Read-only Explorer-Slice.

Stop-Regeln:
- Scope wird verlassen.
- Private Inhalte oder Secrets waeren noetig.
- Du kannst den Status nur aus Chatverlauf statt Repo-Artefakten ableiten.

Wenn fertig:
- Status melden.
- Report liefern.
- Risiken und Handoff nennen.

Bob-Slice: ABC2-bob-runtime-mapping-report

Arbeite im Odysseus-Fork an einem read-only Runtime-Mapping-Report.

Ziel:
- Mappe bestehende PlanGraph/Registry/AgentRun/ContextCapsule/Subagent-Modelle gegen die Anforderungen von roadmap-reconciliation-import.

Erlaubte Dateien:
- src/plan_graph_store.py
- src/orchestration_registry.py
- src/agent_run_store.py
- src/context_capsule.py
- src/subagent_runtime.py
- tests/test_plan_graph_store.py

- tests/test_agent_run_store.py
- tests/test_context_capsule.py
- tests/test_subagent_runtime.py
- tests/test_subagent_runtime_contract.py

Nicht anfassen:
- Keine Codeaenderungen.
- Kein Live-Backend.
- Keine Git-Aktionen.
- Keine breiten Tests ausser read-only Inspektion.

Anforderungen:
- Gib einen AgentReport zurueck.
- Nenne wiederverwendbare Modelle, fehlende Felder, Validator-Luecken und minimale naechste Schema-Slices.
- Trenne klar zwischen vorhandener Fake-Runtime und echter Live-Ausfuehrung.

Tests:
- Keine. Read-only Explorer-Slice.

Stop-Regeln:
- Scope wird verlassen.
- Eine Aussage waere Spekulation ohne source_ref.
- Du muesstest Code aendern.

Wenn fertig:
- Status melden.
- Report liefern.
- Risiken und Handoff nennen.

heartbeat_automation.name: abc-roadmap-reconciliation-import
heartbeat_automation.prompt:
Du bist Charlie im Odysseus-Fork und koordinierst specs/roadmaps/abc-roadmap-reconciliation-import.v1.json bis roadmap-reconciliation-import live auf dem Debian Server installiert ist.

Bei jedem Tick:
1. Pruefe git status --short --branch.
2. Sammle Alice/Bob Reports ein oder sende fehlende read-only Scout-Pakete erneut.
3. Validiere Reports gegen Schema, Scope, Redaction und source_refs.
4. Reduziere nur akzeptierte Reports zu PlanEvents oder strukturierten Roadmap-Updates.
5. Starte keine andere Feature-Implementierung, solange roadmap-reconciliation-import nicht live installiert oder explizit Deferred/No-Go ist.
6. Wenn lokale Aenderungen fertig sind: JSON validieren, scope pruefen, committen und pushen.
7. Nach Push: Live-Server-Installation nur mit operator Go und dokumentiertem updater flow. Danach /api/version und Server-Smoke pruefen.
8. Stoppe bei Secrets, fremden staged files, Scope-Verletzung, unklarem Serverzugang, roten Tests, ungeklärtem Remote/Branch oder Live-Go-Mangel.
9. Wenn Server /api/version den Commit meldet und Smoke gruen ist, loesche die Automation und melde die Handoff-Karte.

Ausgabe kurz: Gesamtfortschritt, Alice/Bob Status, Tests, Commit, Push, Server-Install-Evidence, naechste Aktion.

handoff_card_template.goal: Structured roadmap reconciliation seed is live on the Debian server.
